responsibility: Main lowering engine for ordinary BRIG arithmetic, logical, vector, and miscellaneous basic instructions. This handler constructs GENERIC trees or builtin calls for most non-branching operations, including scalar and vector arithmetic, shuffles, pack/unpack operations, saturating arithmetic, scalarization fallbacks for unsupported vector forms, and result writeback logic, making it the central per-instruction translator for the bulk of HSAIL opcodes.
